question.question: What hand/deck/pile information can players inspect or reveal, and may non-binding deals transfer cards or require consent?

expected.expected_answer: Hand counts public, contents cannot be shown/revealed unless instructed. Face-up piles inspectable/searchable, shared deck not. Agreements non-binding, card giving only when instructed, actions never require consent.

source_passages.section: Special Rules & Edge Cases — hand and agreements
source_passages.quotation: Hand size is public, contents private: reveal/show only if explicitly instructed. Face-up piles may be searched/inspected; deck cannot. Agreements are non-binding; cards may be transferred only as instructed; actions require no consent. (1.2–3.)

answer.ruling: Hand size is public but hand contents are private; reveal or show cards only when explicitly instructed. Face-up piles may be searched or inspected, but the deck may not.
